title: THE PILLAGER BOARD READS AT 16 PX
why: The Codex critic on the raid HUD (o-120d, o-01, o-09f, o-137): the current pillagers rows were about 14 px on the screen at one weight, under the 16 px floor of the style guide, a dense block that competed with the rest of the HUD. The title and the rows go to the label size (about 16.8 px on the screen), the row pitch and the panel width grow to hold them. You stay the bright row, the rivals sit one step back (v36.73).
now: The pillager board text is bigger and easier to read.

edits.replacement: var LW=LH(230),LH1=LH(14);   // v28.xx (cw-hudroster), the critic (o-120d, o-01, o-09f): "eight rows of 14-15px text set at equal weight form a dense block", "rows are about 12px, unreadable from a couch". The rows go to the label size (about 16.8 px on screen, the style guide floor is 16; they were 14), the pitch and the panel width follow it (was 214 wide and 11 a row)
